info.name: CollabDocs - Person B - Documents & Versions
info.description:
Documents and DocumentVersion endpoints (Person B).

Setup: run `python manage.py seed_demo`, then set `token` (alice=admin, bob=editor, carol=viewer, dave=non-member) and `workspace_id` from its output. Or call 'Obtain token' first.
Run 'Create document' first: it stores `document_id`; 'List versions' stores `version_id`.
'Delete document' is in its own folder so a collection run ends with it.
